recentItems.title: Metro Talks with #GigiDeLana for #LIYAB: Mga Himig ng Dakilang Pag-Ibig
recentItems.description:
In this #MetroTalks conversation, #GigiDeLana shares her deep connection to the music of Maestro Ryan Cayabyab and the joy she finds in performing. For Gigi, the stage has always felt like home—and being able to perform Mr. C’s music makes that feeling even more special.

As part of #LIYAB: Mga Himig ng Dakilang Pag-ibig alongside fellow Filipino artists, Gigi opens up about finding a sense of home through music and why she hopes to keep that feeling alive through every performance.

At a time when we need it most, LIYAB is a celebration of love—for God, for country, and for our beloved.

Every ticket helps support: The PGH Medical Foundation & Department of ORL-HNS of PGH and the CCP International Scholarship Fund.

Come together not just to celebrate, but to be inspired - one song, one story, one shared memory at a time.

recentItems.title: Raul Manzano Explores the Reimagined Lagen Island Resort | EIC On The Move
recentItems.description:
Step into paradise as Raul Manzano returns to the newly reimagined Lagen Island Resort in El Nido, Palawan. Set amidst towering limestone cliffs and crystal-clear waters, he explores how the iconic island retreat has been thoughtfully transformed while staying true to its commitment to sustainability and the breathtaking natural beauty that has made it a world-renowned destination.

Along the way, Raul reconnects with his long-time friend and Ayala Land Inc.’s Creative Director, Paloma Urquijo Zobel de Ayala, who shares the vision behind Lagen Island's remarkable evolution. Together, they take viewers behind the scenes of the resort's stunning architectural upgrades and the philosophy of creating a destination where luxury, nature, and Filipino craftsmanship exist in harmony.

From unforgettable ocean adventures and restorative wellness experiences to an exclusive Chef's Table dinner inside a hidden forest cave, Raul uncovers the many ways Lagen Island offers a deeper connection to nature, culture, and community.
